q.hello: Hello! I'm the EVENTUS assistant. I'll help you plan your event and find vendors. It takes a couple of minutes.
q.helloName: Hello, {name}! I'm the EVENTUS assistant. I'll help you plan your event and find vendors. It takes a couple of minutes.
q.name: What should I call you?
q.eventType: What are we celebrating? Feel free to add details right away: date, city, number of guests.
q.date: When is it? An exact date works, or roughly: “in August”, “in six months”.
q.budget: What's the budget for the whole event? I'll use it to suggest the right options.
q.priorities: Where do we start? Pick what matters most to find first.
q.bizName: What's the name of your company or project?
q.phone: Phone for clients. They see it only after booking. You can add it later.
q.tagline: Describe in one sentence what you're great at. For example: “Premium motorcades with drivers in suits”.
q.summaryClient: Here's what we have. Does it look right?
q.summaryVendor: Check your profile. Clients will see it; after review it gets a “Verified” badge.
